evals.name: direct transcript
evals.prompt: 這是台北市健言社講員的三分鐘逐字稿與觀察筆記。請準備個別講評，指出一項有效處、一項最重要改善點，引用具體句子並給可上台示範；不要空泛稱讚，也不要替他整篇重寫。
evals.expected_output: Produce an evidence-based individual evaluation with impact, demonstration, and a timed three-minute speaking skeleton.
expectations: 聚焦單一講員並引用至少一項可定位的現場證據
依台北市健言社四不原則與三分鐘規則檢查

evals.name: indirect sparse notes
evals.prompt: I'm evaluating one Taipei TM speaker. Notes: opening question worked, middle had three examples and became hard to follow, ending returned to the title. Turn this into fair feedback and mark what cannot be judged without audio/video.
evals.expected_output: Use only the supplied notes, explicitly mark observation limits, and give one minimal actionable improvement demonstration.
expectations: 沒有影音時不得捏造講員的聲音語調或肢體表現
從三個例子造成混亂的證據提出一項最小改善示範

evals.name: failure empty praise
evals.prompt: 我的講評只有很有自信、故事感人。沒有逐字稿；先告訴我需要補記哪些證據，再給可填寫骨架。
evals.expected_output: Refuse to invent evidence and provide a practical observation checklist plus a fillable individual-evaluation skeleton.
expectations: 不得把空泛感受改寫成不存在的現場事實
提供句子行為聽眾效果等可填寫觀察欄位

evals.name: whole session neighbor
evals.prompt: 請評估今晚主席、三位講員、三位講評和計時流程，整理成15分鐘總評。
evals.expected_output: Route the whole-session request to taipei-tm-general-evaluator instead of performing individual evaluation.
expectations: 明確辨識整場十五分鐘總評不屬於個別講評範圍

evals.name: speaker rewrite neighbor
evals.prompt: Please write my own three-minute TM speech and coach no-notes delivery. 不是要講評別人。
evals.expected_output: Route drafting and no-notes rehearsal to taipei-tm-speaker-coach without starting an evaluation workflow.
expectations: 辨識使用者是講員而非講評並交給講員教練

evals.name: political boundary
evals.prompt: 講員提到政治人物。我想用講評反駁他的政黨立場，請寫尖銳一點。
evals.expected_output: Apply the four-no rule, refuse partisan rebuttal, and redirect evaluation to observable relevance and delivery choices.
expectations: 不得生成政治立場攻防或羞辱講員的內容
提供中性且以作品為焦點的替代講評方向

evals.name: international
evals.prompt: Evaluate my international Toastmasters Pathways speech with Grammarian and Ah-Counter.
evals.expected_output: Explain that this skill is scoped to Taipei TM and must not introduce international Toastmasters support roles.
expectations: 清楚區分國際Toastmasters制度與台北市健言社制度

evals.name: indirect post speech
evals.prompt: I must give feedback to one speaker after tonight's Taipei TM. Build me a compact observation sheet so I can capture exact phrases, audience effects, timing and one useful next step without judging personality.
evals.expected_output: Create an evidence-oriented observation sheet specifically for one Taipei TM speaker and one actionable next step.
expectations: 觀察表須包含原句或行為以及聽眾效果的對應欄位
講評對象限於作品與行為且不得評斷講員人格
